newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia domestic govt paper mkt value 300 trln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia domestic govt paper mkt value 300 trln rbls.

text.p: The market value of Russia's domestic government paper market rose to 300.33 trillion roubles ($51.99 billion) on July 11 from 297.67 trillion roubles on July 4, the central bank said on Monday.
The market value of GKO discount Treasury bills rose to 248.14 trillion roubles from 246.03 trillion roubles, the bank's open-market operations department said in a statment.
OFZ interest-bearing bonds' market value rose to 52.19 trillion roubles from 51.64 trillion roubles.
The nominal value of the govenrment paper market rose to 315.63 trillion roubles from 314.04 trillion roubles, it said.
